verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.konghq.com that indexes Kong's docs for Gateway, Konnect, AI Gateway and Mesh. Many doc pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md URLs), which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt variant), and independent or community confirmation that agents use it effectively.
